name: CAS Importer
description: Import Indian CAS statements (CAMS/KFintech, NSDL/CDSL) into Wealthfolio
author: Joel Tony

permissions.purpose: Choose the account each PAN's or folio's transactions go to and the bank account their cash comes from and goes to, or the account each folio's, demat account's or PRAN's holdings go to
Warn when another account already holds an asset, so it isn't counted twice
Read the account's holdings on the statement's date, then save the statement's holdings as a snapshot

Check transactions before importing activities, a summary or depository statement's units against accounts that track transactions, and stock splits before carrying holdings into a snapshot. When you choose to use a bank account's deposit or withdrawal for a fund's cash, add the fund's transfer, change the bank's row into a transfer if it isn't one, and link the two; transfers already linked aren't offered
Read Wealthfolio's timezone, so a statement's units are checked against activities on the days Wealthfolio counts them
Find each asset by the ISIN or name printed on the statement, or by what you type, and check existing assets before using statement prices
Save the statement's price for holdings priced by hand on the statement's date, and keep the last price of those carried over, instead of the average cost a snapshot save writes there

Read assets' current pricing mode and, to check a statement's units, the symbol and exchange of the assets in accounts that track transactions, and keep the printed details of bonds, NPS schemes, and funds and shares priced from statements on their Wealthfolio assets
Keep the statement password when you tick Remember, and forget it
